title: Kanav Dhir of VergeSense: Driving Innovation in Workplace Intelligence
summary: Meet Kanav Dhir of VergeSense, the executive advancing AI‑powered workplace intelligence and occupancy analytics to optimize space utilization and strategy.
body_markdown:
By: Pulse2.0


This profile highlights Kanav Dhir, a key leader at VergeSense, and his pivotal role in transforming workplace intelligence and occupancy analytics. Under his guidance, VergeSense has advanced its AI‑powered capabilities to deliver actionable insights on space utilization and employee experience. The article explores Dhir’s background, vision, and the strategic innovations shaping commercial real estate operations via data‑driven technology.
